theme: Light/Dark toggle supported, default to sleek light mode

typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep jump between heading and subheading within 2 Tailwind steps.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for nav/headers (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl). Flat solid surfaces for product cards with 1px border. No Neumorphism.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton on the admin panel with border-collapse styles.

components.product_card: Image on top (aspect-square object-cover), details below. Left-align text. Promotion badge absolute top-left.
components.admin_dashboard: High Density Grid (Bento). Tight gaps. Focus on data correlation.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Solid colors. Hover: scale slightly or translate-y-px.

grids_and_layouts.catalog: Asymmetrical Tetris grid or generous standard grid (gap-8 to gap-12).
grids_and_layouts.admin: Dense bento grid (gap-4). Every pixel utilized.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use generous spacing (p-8, p-12) for marketing/storefront sections.

motion_and_interactions.framer_motion: Mandatory for page transitions, smooth stagger effects on product lists.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Hover states must explicitly set text color. Images scale up 5% on hover.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

media.images: Do not exceed 80vh on mobile. Max overlay opacity bg-black/50 for hero banners.

3d_and_creative_libraries: framer-motion (for smooth page/item transitions as requested)
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement two distinct areas: Customer Storefront and Admin Dashboard.
Customer Storefront: Display product catalog. Show 'quantity in stock' and distinct badges for 'promotions'. Allow customers to add to cart, mock checkout, and view order history.
Admin Dashboard: Allow admin to edit products, prices, stock quantities, and promotions. View past orders.

CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: When stock of ANY product equals 1, trigger a visually prominent alert on the Admin Dashboard (e.g., pulsating red badge or banner) AND fire a 'sonner' toast notification alerting the admin.
Ensure 'bem moderno com transição' (modern with transitions): Heavy use of framer-motion for smooth route changes, modal openings, and list staggering.
Implement simple JWT-based auth for User vs Admin separation.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters. Use proper icon libraries (lucide-react).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays, headers, or dropdowns. Always use glassmorphism or solid colors.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
